$schema_note: ForteL2 rail interface for SettlementOS and explorers. Version bumps when chain ID, bridge proxies, or reset policy change.

fortel2-local.label: ForteL2 (local Anvil L1)

bridge.note: Addresses in deployments/deployments.json after local deploy; ephemeral across reset.sh

fortel2-local.resetPolicy: May re-genesis anytime via ./scripts/reset.sh. SOS must redeploy contracts after reset.
fortel2-local.notes: Optional offline SOS testing only. Prefer fortel2-sepolia for the real integration path.

fortel2-sepolia.label: ForteL2 (Sepolia L1)

bridge.funding: L2 accounts funded via L1→L2 deposit (no genesis fundDevAccounts). Use deposit-eth-sepolia.sh patterns.

replica.note: No Mac-reachable replica RPC URL exists (D-0016). Access is Render private-service Web Shell only — see tasks/decisions.md D-0016 and replica/README.md.
updateTriggers: Phase 7 Sepolia redeploy / network-wide wipe only while deployment pinned through Phase 6
After redeploy: pack-replica-artifacts.sh → publish genesis+rollup → wipe Mac data-sepolia AND Render /data → hash cross-check

fortel2-sepolia.resetPolicy: Phase 6 completed 2026-08-04. The 2026-07-22 deployment remains pinned — 852 is the staging chain per D-0018. The next redeploy is the Phase 7 / mainnet-pilot gate and is a coordinated network-wide wipe.
fortel2-sepolia.notes: Primary SOS target. Writes: Mac sequencer L2 RPC (loopback today). Reads today land on the sequencer endpoint; the replica has no reachable URL (D-0016). Do not share QuickNode L1 URL/token with Render.

availability.note: Personal L2 on a Mac mini. No uptime commitment. The sequencer RPC is stopped nightly; writes and reads against the sequencer will fail during the window. Replica derivation resumes automatically from L1 after wake.

replica: Current deploy is a Render private service checked via the Render Web Shell (python3/urllib against localhost:10000 EL, :9545 op-node). scripts/replica-sync-check.sh applies only if a Mac-reachable replica endpoint ever exists.

openQuestions: networkId string not yet confirmed by SettlementOS (fortel2-sepolia vs forte-l2) — must match the SOS network registry entry
